The [[Motorola 68000]] is a [[VonNeumann]] machine, so this one CPU reaches both code and
data over one [[Bus]], stepped by the [[Clock]]. [[Cache]] exists because [[Main memory]]
cannot keep up with it. What is actually inside the CU and the [[ALU]] is
[[COMPUTING MACHINERY 2]]'s subject.
